⏰ 3 hours later I have it working as a feature!

Real video-to-3d with my own built headless Blender on a VPS

You can upload a walkthrough video of your living room or entire floor

Interior AI turns it into a walkable 3d space where you can paint your walls, move everything around and get a floor plan

It's a quick prototype but it works!

LIVE now on 🏡 Interior AI for all users 😊 🙏 

Thanks @wesbos for a lot of the inspiration here too

这是个快速原型，但确实能用！

现已在 🏡 Interior AI 上对所有用户 LIVE 上线 😊 🙏 

也感谢 @wesbos 给了很多灵感

quoted.text:
There wasn't much technology to work with in terms of interior design with my app 🏡 Interior AI the last 12 months

For 4 years it's been based on simple image models: photos of your interior as input -> redesigns out as output

But now there is a completely new dimension to it 😬

As you probably saw on your timeline, AI can finally generate headless Blender 3d scenes from just a rough video (which I did today of my living room), or even a few photos, and even a floorplan (which no image model was able to understand before, believe me I tried 100 times!)

That means that 3d scene I can then make fully editable in my app Interior AI

Meaning you can paint any wall, floor or ceiling any color, next move around, delete or add new furniture etc from a giant 3d library of furniture

Endless possibilities!!

I think I found my next big feature 😍

I'll try get something live in Interior AI within the next few hours!!!
quoted.text_zh:
过去 12 个月，我的应用 🏡 Interior AI 在室内设计方面能用的技术其实并不多

4 年来，它一直基于简单的图像模型：输入你室内的照片 -> 输出重新设计的效果图

但现在它有了一个全新的维度 😬

你大概已经在时间线上看到了，AI 终于可以从一段粗糙的视频（我今天就拍了自己的客厅）、甚至几张照片，甚至一张平面图（以前没有图像模型能理解平面图，相信我，我试过 100 次！）生成无头 Blender 3D 场景

这意味着我可以在 Interior AI 里把那个 3D 场景做成完全可编辑的

也就是说，你可以把任何墙面、地板或天花板涂成任意颜色，接着四处移动、删除或从超大的 3D 家具库里添加新家具等等

无限可能！！

我想我找到了下一个大功能 😍

我会尽量在接下来几个小时内，把这个功能在 Interior AI 里上线！！！

quoted.text:
💪 My personal trainer is also a consultant for many gyms in Portugal

And she now uses 🏡 Interior AI to redesign gyms

She first builds a concept in SketchUp, then uploads that basic wireframe to Interior AI which turns it into a photorealistic render in a few seconds

Then she taps [ Make 3d ] and a few minutes later, she can walk around in her new design in 3d (thanks to @theworldlabs API)

Very very very useful to show her gym clients how it'll look!
quoted.text_zh:
💪 我的私人教练同时也是葡萄牙许多健身房的顾问

她现在会用 🏡 Interior AI 改造健身房

她先在 SketchUp 里做一个概念，再把那个基础线框上传到 Interior AI，几秒钟就能变成照片级渲染

然后她点 [ Make 3d ]，几分钟后就能在 3D 里走动查看新设计（感谢 @theworldlabs API）

非常非常非常适合拿给她的健身房客户展示效果！
